plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a story by the journalist Ross Coulthart on the news channel NewsNation about a man named Jake Barber, who says he was part of a team that recovered crashed unidentified craft using "psionic assets": people said to use their minds to psychically call in strange material. In a later episode Michels adds that these people were called P3s, short for people with psionic potential, who act as a bridge, ties the work to bringing craft down, and also credits another whistleblower, Michael Herrera. If true, it would mean the government uses mental abilities to reach non-human craft.
